name: libar-platform
description: The Convex transactional domain platform: its design as a Software Delivery Protocol corpus, and the code built from it.

scripts.sdp:build: npx sdp build && node scripts/pinned.mjs --pack pack:history-view --name history-view
scripts.lint: eslint src fixture example harness tests scripts vitest.config.ts vitest.hosted.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src fixture example harness tests scripts evidence/README.md README.md package.json tsconfig.json convex.json vitest.config.ts vitest.hosted.config.ts eslint.config.js .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/hosted.yml .prettierrc.json
scripts.test:types: npm run sdp:build && vitest run --project types
scripts.test:native: npm run sdp:build && vitest run --project native
scripts.test: npm run sdp:build && vitest run --project types --project pure --project simulator
scripts.test:hosted: npm run sdp:build && vitest run --config vitest.hosted.config.ts
